title: 1NSANE car classes: a proposal (phase 1, for review)
status: proposal only: nothing in the game is changed

updated.what: the nine cars that drove off on their own during the countdown (Porsche 911 AWD Turbo, fido's drag "nos", dragster, Nissan Silvia Drift, Nissan Silvia Falken, Mclaren Based KitCar, Knight Rider's K.I.T.T., N.O.S. Mitsubishi Eclipse, Toyota Supra) are held at the start by the port since; re-measured from a standing start and classed by the same rules, they leave UNLIMITED.

two .vht mass slips fixed as the car loads (runtime/fancars.c): Dakar (dakar) 10000 t, kilograms typed where tonnes go, taken as 10 t; Army Transporter (armytran) 358.47 t, the decimal point two places off, taken as 3.5847 t. The mass only counts in collisions (and the AI's heavy-vehicle steering, over 4 t); re-measured with the same drive test, both drive exactly as before (Dakar 163 km/h, 0-100 4.1 s; Army Transporter 183 km/h, 0-100 2.7 s) and stay in FAST TRUCKS by the same rules.

Ant: "the bonus cars should be in the right categories, not a bonus category". The seven stock bonus cars are classed by type and measured speed with the fan cars' rules, and BONUS is gone: ATV QUADS & BIKES, Raider 4X4 (within the stock 4X4 cars' window), Wrecker and Police MUSCLE & CLASSICS, Speeder ODDITIES, Rally 2.0i and Rallycroxx RALLY. Each is still won in its championship as before (the port keeps it locked until then). And "the monster jeep shouldn't be in the monster truck category": the Monster YJ is a lifted Jeep Wrangler YJ (winch, snorkel, light bar) on 0.42 m tyres, as the 93 Jeep YJ by the same author (the monster trucks: 0.6-0.84 m), with stock-like gearing; a compact 4x4 within the SPORTS window (167 km/h, 0-50 1.5 s): SPORTS.

Inticer (inticer) to DESERT RACERS and the Post Nuclear McLaren (mcpn) to MONSTER TRUCKS: classed from their names before; Ant: "the inticer is a truck", "the post nuclear mclaren is a monster truck" (a prerunner pickup; a McLaren body on monster tyres)

how_classes_work.where_a_class_comes_from: Each car's .vht has a line 'group <letter>'; the first letter is the car's group (case counts: the one fan car with 'T' is a class of its own). Start-up (0x47d8a0) reads it into the car list (+0x30) while listing Data\Vehicles.
how_classes_work.how_classes_are_built: Right after data\champdef.cfg is read (0x47d280), classes 0-4 are the five championships' letters (x 4X4, c SPORTS, p PICKUPS, t TRUCKS, w EXTREME); every other letter gets the next class number in order of first appearance in the car list (file names in order). The car list is then sorted by class and each class gets its list of cars. With Ant's folders: 8 classes, x 270, o 92, t 27, w 16, p 9, c 8, b 7, T 1. Only the five championship classes have names (menu_text.cfg array 'class': 4X4, SPORTS, PICKUPS, TRUCKS, EXTREME, two blanks, FREE).
what_a_class_drives: Vehicle > Browse lists the cars grouped by class (class order), with no class names.
Championships: the event screen's VEHICLE (Left/Right) walks only the championship class's cars; the AI opponents come from the same class.

AI opponents (0x45e500, race set-up OPPONENTS): 'same' = the player's car in other paints; 'class' = unlocked cars with the player's letter; 'free' = unlocked cars of the five championship letters. 'class' and 'free' collect at most 100 car/paint pairs in list order, so with 270 4x4s only about the first 20 by file name (Fiat 126p to Anakin's podracer) ever appear as opponents, and 'free' only ever reaches the first 4x4s. An 'o' car racing 'class' opponents gets copies of itself.

Unlocks (0x46e690): every car locked, then the cars of each open championship's letter, the 'o' cars always, each championship's bonus car when earned; ineedmorecars unlocks all. Fan cars with any other letter (the 'T' truck, any fan 'b' car) stay locked without the code.
Network games: the host picks CLASS 4X4/SPORTS/PICKUPS/TRUCKS/EXTREME (a letter) or FREE (0x46a3a0).
The player file (Player00.chp), the registry (Quick_/Practice_/Champ_ Vehicle), replays and championship records keep car file names and points, not classes: none of them change with classes.
The menus' vehicle statistics (ACCELERATION, TOP SPEED, STABILITY) are the .vht's [menu] ratings, written by each author; DRIVE is worked out from the wheels' 'driven' flags.
how_classes_work.more_classes: Any new letter becomes a class by itself: the class table had room for 16, and mods.c already moved the class lists to room for 107. Championships are fixed at five: five records of 0x7f0 bytes (0x1c3c4cc), five menu lines and background pictures, champwin1-5.cfg, five records in the player file. New championships would need new menu pages, records and a new save format: not proposed. New classes are race classes: they group the cars in Browse and choose the 'class' opponents in Quick Race and Practice.

method.files: Every car the game lists (stock + Ant's three folders, resolved as runtime/mods.c does: 24 stock, 406 fan; 2 left out by the game itself), its .vht (XFF text) and physics nodes (.vhx/.vhd) read from its .idf, readers from ~/DevWork/1nsane-rip/tools copied to work/classes/tools (the rip folder only read). Node units are 0.015 m (the Baja Bug comes out 3.6 m long, 2.43 m wheelbase).
method.drive_test: Every car on the flat Speed-Zone map (the object-free version), Off-Road Race, no opponents, throttle held from before the start, steering straight, 40 s; the player's speed logged every frame (prompts.c's INSANE_HINTS_LOG; x5.4 = km/h, checked against the speedometer). Measured: top speed, times to 50/100/150 km/h, roll-overs, and whether the car loads, sits still at the start and drives.
method.limits: Straight line on flat ground only: no hill climbing, cornering, jumps or damage. Very fast cars (250+ km/h) may meet the map's edge before their true top speed. Fan cars mostly have far more power than the stock ones, so the stock cars set the championship windows.
method.types: Each car's real vehicle and type come from its name, download name, readme and size (work/classes/types.py, by hand); '?' where unclear.

classes.name: 4X4
classes.description: Off-road 4x4s and SUVs: the 4X4 championship (Baja Bug, Blaze, Cairo).
classes.criteria: Stock 4X4 cars; fan 4x4s and SUVs, and the bonus Raider, as quick as the stock ones (top speed and 0-100 km/h within the stock range plus a margin).
classes.unlock: as shipped: when its championship opens

classes.name: SPORTS
classes.description: Light utility 4x4s: the SPORTS championship (Samu, Wyle, Bear).
classes.criteria: Stock SPORTS cars; fan compact 4x4s (Jeep CJ/Wrangler, Willys, Suzuki, Land Rover Series, Niva) as quick as the stock ones.
classes.unlock: as shipped: when its championship opens

classes.name: PICKUPS
classes.description: Pickups: the PICKUPS championship (Bushwhacker, Utility, Sodar).
classes.criteria: Stock pickups; fan pickups as quick as the stock ones.
classes.unlock: as shipped: when its championship opens

classes.name: TRUCKS
classes.description: Heavy trucks: the TRUCKS championship (6x6 Goliath, 8x8 Behemoth, 4x4 Freighter).
classes.criteria: Stock trucks; fan heavy trucks, military trucks and Unimogs as quick as the stock ones.
classes.unlock: as shipped: when its championship opens

classes.name: EXTREME
classes.description: Light, high-powered hillclimbers: the EXTREME championship (Cliffhanger, Coyote, Hillclimber).
classes.criteria: Stock EXTREME cars; fan hillclimb buggies built the same way (light, very high power to weight, low gearing).
classes.unlock: as shipped: when its championship opens

classes.name: 4X4 OPEN
classes.description: Fan 4x4s, SUVs and pickups too quick for the championship classes (most fan cars are tuned well past the stock ones).
classes.criteria: Fan compact 4x4s, SUVs and pickups outside the 4X4, SPORTS and PICKUPS performance windows.

classes.name: FAST TRUCKS
classes.description: Heavy trucks too quick for the TRUCKS championship: rally trucks, semis and 8x8s tuned for speed.
classes.criteria: Fan heavy trucks outside the TRUCKS performance window.

classes.name: ROCK CRAWLERS
classes.description: Rock-crawler builds: big tyres, low gearing, made for climbing rather than speed.
classes.criteria: Fan crawler builds (name, download or a crawler suspension), any speed.

classes.name: DESERT RACERS
classes.description: Trophy trucks, prerunners, Baja buggies, sandrails, Class 5 cars and rally-raid machines.

classes.name: RALLY
classes.description: Rally cars and small road cars: hatchbacks, saloons, rally replicas.
classes.criteria: Fan rally cars and small road cars; the bonus Rally 2.0i and Rallycroxx.

classes.name: MUSCLE & CLASSICS
classes.description: Muscle cars and classic saloons, coupes and roadsters (many converted to 4x4).
classes.criteria: Fan muscle cars and classics; the bonus Wrecker and Police.

classes.name: MONSTER TRUCKS
classes.description: Monster trucks and mud boggers on giant tyres.

classes.name: VANS & BUSES
classes.description: Vans, minibuses, buses, coaches and motorhomes.

classes.name: QUADS & BIKES
classes.criteria: Fan ATVs, quads and bikes; the bonus ATV.

classes.name: DRAG & RACE
classes.description: Dragsters, drag cars, sprint and dirt-track cars, Formula 1: built for one kind of race.

classes.name: ODDITIES
classes.description: Planes, boats, hovercraft, sci-fi speeders, work machines and joke vehicles (the stock Gnu and Aeroplane were here already). As shipped, "class" opponents for an 'o' car are copies of it.
classes.criteria: Stock 'o' cars and the bonus Speeder; fan vehicles that aren't cars or trucks: aircraft, boats, hovercraft, speeders, tractors, diggers, tanks, toys.

classes.name: UNLIMITED
classes.description: Fan cars far beyond everything of their kind: absurd speed. They would win any class. (The nine cars that drove off on their own during the countdown are held at the start by the port since 2026-10-19 and classed by their measured speed.)
classes.criteria: Measured top speed over 1.6 times its class median, over 400 km/h, or moving before the start.

decisions_for_ant: Which fan cars may join the five championship classes: the proposal lets in fan cars of the matching kind whose top speed is at most 15% above the fastest stock car of the class and whose 0-50 km/h is no more than 30% quicker; the rest go to 4X4 OPEN or FAST TRUCKS. Alternatives: no fan cars in championship classes at all, or a looser window.

SPORTS as 'compact 4x4s' (Jeep CJ/Wrangler, Willys, Suzuki, Land Rover Series and Defender 90, Niva) and 4X4 as 'full-size 4x4s and SUVs' (Cherokee, Blazer, Bronco, Scout, Land Cruiser, G-Class): this follows the stock cars (Samu and Wyle are a Samurai and a Willys; Cairo and Blaze a Defender and a Grand Cherokee) but the stock Bear (Hummer-like) sits in SPORTS and the Baja Bug in 4X4.
Unlocks for the new race classes: always unlocked (like ODDITIES), or tied to a championship (e.g. 4X4 OPEN with the 4X4 championship).

The 5 cars that crash the game when they race (BMW M5, Celica GT, Monster Hummer, Bugatti Veyron) or don't drive (Mini Cooper S): leave them out of the lists, or keep them and fix the crashes in the port.

UNLIMITED (17 cars as proposed: 9 that drove off on their own during the countdown, since held at the start by the port and classed by their measured speed, and 8 absurdly fast): keep it as a class, or leave those cars out of the opponents.
Opponents: lift the 100 car/paint-pair limit for 'class' and 'free' (so every car of a class can be an opponent), and make 'free' cover every class except ODDITIES and UNLIMITED.
Class names and order: the names here are a first go (menu font is upper case); the order in Browse would be the championship classes, BONUS, then the race classes as listed.
New downloads not in the table: keep their own letter (as today), or sort them automatically by name and a quick test.

implementation.option: Enhanced option CAR CLASSES: ORIGINAL / REORGANIZED (options.txt car_classes). ORIGINAL is the game as shipped, byte for byte (lockstep identical); REORGANIZED applies the table. Read at start-up (the lists and classes are built once): a change takes effect at the next start, as the menu note would say. Only matters with fan content (stock cars keep their classes).
implementation.data: The approved table ships with the port: file name -> class letter, plus each class's name and order (e.g. assets/car_classes.txt, made from proposal.json). A user file car_classes.txt in the user folder can override or add entries (new downloads).
runtime: mods.c's champdef hook (0x47d280) runs once the car list is complete and before the classes are built: with REORGANIZED it rewrites each car's group letter (+0x30) from the table. The game then builds the classes and sorts the list by itself.

Class order: the game numbers the non-championship letters by first appearance; to get the table's order, renumber the classes and re-sort the list once after start-up builds them (same data structures mods.c already relocates).
Class names: a menu variable with the chosen car's class name (vehicle screen 'Class: ROCK CRAWLERS'), in the Browse hint line (picker.c) and in championship class headers where shown.

Opponents (0x45e500, opponents.c already hooks it): 'class' already works by letter; raise the 100-pair limit; 'free' to cover all classes except ODDITIES and UNLIMITED. The other helper's stock-cars-only option filters the same pool, so the two combine.
Unlocks (0x46e690): after it runs, unlock the new race classes' cars (as the game does for 'o').
unchanged: The five championships, their stock cars, bonus cars, targets and points.
Saves: Player00.chp, the registry and replays keep car file names; switching the option never breaks them. A championship in progress keeps working; its VEHICLE choice shows the class as reorganized.
Network games' classes stay the five + FREE; both sides need the same option (network is parked).
implementation.effort: About 300-400 lines: the table loader and letter rewrite in mods.c, class renumbering, a class-name menu variable and hint text, the opponents and unlock hooks, the Enhanced option. Checks: lockstep with ORIGINAL, every class's Browse page, Quick Race 'class' and 'free' opponents from a new class, a championship with a fan car, saves across the switch.
